title: HDMI Cables - Different Cable Types
supports: Standard cable tested for 720p/1080i; High Speed cable listed at up to 10.2 Gbps (1080p, 4K30); Premium High Speed certified 18 Gbps (4K60); Ultra High Speed 48 Gbps (4K120/8K60).

title: Premium High Speed HDMI Cable certification
supports: Premium High Speed cables are tested to the full 18 Gbps for 4K@60.

title: Ultra High Speed HDMI Cable
supports: Ultra High Speed cables support up to 48 Gbps.

title: HDMI Specification 1.4b
supports: HDMI 1.4b adds 4K support (4K at up to 30 Hz).

title: HDMI Specification overview (now HDMI 2.2; formerly the HDMI 2.1 page)
supports: The HDMI 2.1/2.2 family uses Fixed Rate Link (FRL); 48 Gbps FRL is the HDMI 2.1 level carried by Ultra High Speed cables (see hdmi-uhs).

title: HDMI - main specifications and refresh-frequency limits tables
supports: TMDS 8b/10b coding: HDMI 1.4 max 10.2 Gbps raw = 8.16 Gbps data; HDMI 2.0 18 Gbps raw = 14.4 Gbps data; HDMI 2.1 FRL 48 Gbps raw with 16b/18b = 42.67 Gbps data; CTA-861 timings (1080p60 148.5 MHz, 4K30 297 MHz, 4K60 594 MHz).

title: DisplayPort - link rates, DP++ dual-mode, cables
supports: HBR2 4 lanes 21.6 Gbps raw = 17.28 Gbps data; HBR3 32.4 Gbps raw = 25.92 Gbps data; UHBR10 40 Gbps raw (128b/132b) = 38.69 Gbps data; DP++ passive adapters need a dual-mode source; DP8K cables certified for UHBR10.

title: DisplayPort Alt Mode over USB Type-C (USB DevDays 2019)
supports: DP Alt Mode uses up to 4 high-speed lanes of a full-featured USB Type-C cable at DP 1.4 HBR3 (8.1 Gbps/lane); 2-lane mode leaves the other pairs for USB 3.

title: Coordinated Video Timings (CVT reduced blanking)
supports: CVT-RB pixel clocks, e.g. 2560x1440@60 = 241.5 MHz; 1920x1200@60 = 154 MHz.

title: USB-C - cable types, alternate modes, power
supports: USB 2.0-only Type-C cables have no SuperSpeed pairs, so cannot carry DisplayPort Alt Mode; full-featured cables can; 3 A cables = 60 W, 5 A e-marked = 100 W (SPR), EPR cables = 240 W.

title: Thunderbolt (interface)
supports: Thunderbolt 3/4 over USB-C carries DisplayPort and USB PD up to 100 W on copper cables.

title: USB-IF Cables and Connectors
supports: Certified USB Type-C cable power ratings (60 W / 240 W logos) and data ratings.

title: USB Charger (USB Power Delivery)
supports: USB PD up to 100 W (SPR, 20 V 5 A) and up to 240 W with PD 3.1 EPR (48 V 5 A).

title: VGA connector
supports: Analog VGA commonly carries up to 1920x1200@60; quality depends on cable and converter.

title: MacBook Air (M2, 2022) - Tech Specs
supports: Two Thunderbolt/USB 4 ports with charging and DisplayPort; one external display up to 6K60; MagSafe 3; ships with 30 W or 35 W adapter; fast-charge with 70 W adapter.

title: MacBook Pro (14-inch, M3, Nov 2023) - Tech Specs
supports: Two Thunderbolt/USB 4 ports (charging, DisplayPort); HDMI output up to 4K at 120 Hz (M3); one external display up to 6K60; 70 W adapter in box; fast-charge with 96 W.

title: About the Apple USB-C Digital AV Multiport Adapter
supports: Model A2119: 3840x2160@60 with MacBook Air 2020+ and 14-inch MacBook Pro 2021+; model A1621: 3840x2160@30 and up to 1080p60.

title: Use a power adapter with your Mac
supports: Recommended adapters: MacBook Air 2022+ 30/35/67/70 W; 14-inch MacBook Pro 2021+ 67/70/96 W; any USB PD adapter can charge a USB-C Mac.

title: Fast charge your MacBook Air or MacBook Pro
supports: MacBook Air 2022+ fast charges with 67/70/96/140 W adapters + MagSafe 3 or USB-C charge cable; 14-inch MacBook Pro fast charges with 96/140 W adapters (or a display delivering 94 W).

title: USB-C to MagSafe 3 Cable (2 m)
supports: Apple USB-C to MagSafe 3 cable, used with the 140 W adapter for 16-inch MacBook Pro fast charging (see apple-fastcharge).

title: ThinkPad X1 Carbon Gen 11 - PSREF specifications
supports: 2x Thunderbolt 4 / USB4 (PD 3.0, DisplayPort 1.4a); 1x HDMI 2.1 up to 4K/60Hz; 45 W or 65 W USB-C adapters; Rapid Charge with 65 W.

title: HDMI Forum releases version 2.0 of the HDMI Specification (press release)
supports: HDMI 2.0 raises bandwidth to 18 Gbps and adds 4K@50/60 (2160p). Also states that existing High Speed (Category 2) cables carry the 18 Gbps rate.

title: VESA Tokyo Workshop, October 2024 (DisplayPort and cable certification overview)
supports: DPv1.2 = HBR2 (5.4 Gbps/lane), DPv1.4 = HBR3 (8.1 Gbps/lane), DPv2.x = UHBR10/13.5/20. DP8K cables: up to 4-lane HBR3. DP54: up to UHBR13.5. DP80: UHBR20.

title: VESA strengthens 8K video resolution ecosystem with DP8K-certified DisplayPort cables (press release)
supports: DP8K certification covers the full HBR3 rate (32.4 Gbps across 4 lanes) defined in DisplayPort 1.3/1.4.

title: MacBook Air (M1, 2020) - Tech Specs
supports: Two Thunderbolt / USB 4 ports with charging and DisplayPort; one external display up to 6K60; 30W USB-C Power Adapter.

title: MacBook Air (13-inch, M3, 2024) - Tech Specs
supports: Two Thunderbolt / USB 4 ports (charging, DisplayPort); MagSafe 3; one external display up to 6K60; 30W or 35W adapter; fast-charge capable with 70W.

title: MacBook Air (13-inch, M4, 2025) - Tech Specs
supports: Two Thunderbolt 4 (USB-C) ports with native DisplayPort 1.4 output; MagSafe 3; up to two external displays up to 6K60; fast-charge capable with 70W.

title: MacBook Pro (14-inch, M4, 2024) - Tech Specs
supports: Three Thunderbolt 4 ports with native DisplayPort 1.4; HDMI up to 8K60 or 4K240; MagSafe 3; 70W adapter; fast-charge capable with 96W.

title: iPhone 15 - Tech Specs
supports: USB-C with USB 2 (480 Mb/s) and DisplayPort; video out up to 4K HDR via native DisplayPort over USB-C or the A2119 adapter; fast-charge with a 20W adapter or higher.

title: iPhone 15 Pro - Tech Specs
supports: USB-C with USB 3 (up to 10 Gb/s) and DisplayPort; video out up to 4K HDR; fast-charge with a 20W adapter or higher.

title: iPhone 16 - Tech Specs
supports: USB-C with USB 2 and DisplayPort; video out up to 4K HDR; fast-charge with a 20W adapter or higher.

title: iPad (10th generation) - Tech Specs
supports: USB-C with DisplayPort; external display up to 4K at 30 Hz or 1080p at 60 Hz (per Apple's display support note); 20W USB-C adapter.

title: iPad Air 11-inch (M2) - Tech Specs
supports: USB-C with DisplayPort and USB 3; one external display up to 6K at 60 Hz; 20W USB-C adapter.

title: About the Apple USB-C VGA Multiport Adapter
supports: VGA up to 1080p (1920x1080) at 60 Hz; USB-C port is for charging only (max 60W), not data or video.

title: About the Apple Thunderbolt Pro Cables
supports: Thunderbolt 4 Pro Cable: 40 Gbps, DisplayPort HBR3 video, up to 100W. Thunderbolt 5 Pro Cable: up to 120 Gbps, HBR3 video, up to 240W. Apple USB-C Charge Cable: USB 2 (480 Mbps), no video.

title: 240W USB-C Charge Cable (2 m)
supports: Charges up to 240W; transfers data at USB 2 speeds (480 Mb/s).

title: ThinkPad X1 Carbon Gen 12 - PSREF
supports: 2x Thunderbolt 4 / USB4 with USB PD 3.0 and DisplayPort 2.1; HDMI 2.1 up to 4K/60Hz; 45W/65W USB-C adapters; Rapid Charge with 65W.

title: ThinkPad T14 Gen 4 (Intel) - PSREF
supports: 2x Thunderbolt 4 / USB4 (PD 3.0, DisplayPort 1.4); HDMI 2.1 up to 4K/60Hz; 45W or 65W USB-C PD 3.0 adapters; Rapid Charge.

title: ThinkPad E14 Gen 5 (Intel) - PSREF
supports: 1x Thunderbolt 4 and 1x USB-C 3.2 Gen 2, both with PD 3.0 and DisplayPort 1.4; HDMI 2.1 up to 4096x2160@60Hz; 65W USB-C adapter.

title: IdeaPad Slim 3 15IRU8 - PSREF
supports: HDMI 1.4 up to 4K@30Hz; USB-C 3.2 Gen 1 with USB PD 45-65W and DisplayPort 1.2, up to 4K@60Hz; 65W round-tip adapter.

title: ThinkVision T27h-30 - PSREF
supports: 2560x1440 panel; USB-C 3.2 Gen 1 with DP 1.4 Alt Mode and up to 90W PD; HDMI 2.1 TMDS (2560x1440@60Hz); DisplayPort 1.4.

title: ThinkVision P27u-20 - PSREF
supports: 3840x2160 panel; Thunderbolt 4 In; 2x HDMI 2.1 TMDS (3840x2160@60Hz); DisplayPort 1.2; downstream USB-C 3.2 Gen 1 is data (and up to 27W) only.

title: ThinkPad Universal USB-C Dock - datasheet
supports: 2x DisplayPort 1.4 and 1x HDMI 2.0, multi 4K@60Hz; charges the notebook at 65W with the included 90W adapter (100W with a 135W adapter).

supports: 2x Thunderbolt 4 USB-C 40Gbps (USB Power Delivery, DisplayPort 1.4); HDMI 2.1 up to 4K@60Hz; HP Smart 45W or 65W USB-C adapter.

title: Surface USB4 Dock - technical overview
supports: HDMI 2.1 and two video-enabled USB4 USB-C ports; two 4K60 monitors; 100W power supply with 65W delivered to the host.

title: Use the Surface USB-C Travel Hub
supports: HDMI 2.0 up to 3840x2160@60Hz; VGA up to 1920x1080@60Hz (not at the same time); USB-C port for USB-C devices (data, phone charging), not for video.

title: Thunderbolt Station 4 (TS4)
supports: DisplayPort 1.4 port plus downstream Thunderbolt 4 ports for displays; USB-C and USB-A ports are data only; 98W laptop charging.

supports: 100W max from a single USB-C port.

title: HDMI (3rd Gen) Expansion Card
supports: USB-C to HDMI 2.0b expansion card, 4K at 60Hz.

title: Connect your Pixel phone to a display (Pixel Phone Help)
supports: Wired display output with a USB-C to DisplayPort or HDMI cable is supported on Pixel 8 and later.

title: Use the Samsung DeX screen on your Galaxy phone or tablet
supports: DeX with a DeX or HDMI cable on Galaxy S8 to S26 series; the Z Flip7 FE and previous Z Flip models are not compatible with DeX or HDMI cable output.

supports: USB-C with DP Alternate Mode, 3840x2160@60Hz and 96W Power Delivery; 2x HDMI and 1x DisplayPort at 3840x2160@60Hz.

supports: HDMI 1.4 up to 4K@30Hz; USB-C 3.2 Gen 1 with Power Delivery and DisplayPort 1.2, up to 4K@60Hz; 65W round-tip adapter.
